name: spotlight-card4
title: Proximity Spotlight Card
description: A single dark card pairing a city-at-dusk photo with a heading and a line about supported technologies. A faint spotlight follows the pointer near it.
use: One feature needs a visual card that still feels alive as the pointer passes.
avoid: The photo is a local webp and the card width is fixed, so both need edits to reuse.
a11y: The photo's alt text is just "grid", so it does not describe the skyline. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One dark rounded card floating on black, with a wide dusk cityscape photo near the top, a white centred heading and three grey centred lines of small body text beneath.
behaves: A soft proximity spotlight brightens a patch of the card as the pointer approaches, though in the clip the card looks almost still. Nothing is clickable.
customise: The image, heading and copy are written into the card; only the spotlight wrapper's mode and width can change.
weight: light: One card and one gradient; no loop or canvas.
demo: Heading "Seamless Animation For All" over a dusk skyline, naming React, Next.js and Tailwind
issues: The spotlight barely registers in the clip, so the effect is hard to judge.
The image alt text is the generic word "grid".
polishWhy: Solid dark card with a strong photo; the glow is nearly invisible and the copy is tiny.
